title: Frontier River Guides

services.name: Alaska Fly Fishing Float Trips
services.desc: At Frontier River Guides we realize that planning for a fly fishing float trip in Alaska may have been a lifelong dream and ambition. We treat each Wilderness Alaska float trip as if this were the case, and will do everything within our capabilities to place you on the right river, at the right time, for the kind of fantastic experience you deserve. We offer only private, customized Alaska float fishing trips, our river expeditions are tailored to your group and we do not combine small groups into large parties of 8-10 people. Remote Alaska float trips are our area of specialization and wilderness adventures are our passion. We bring a fun, pioneering spirit to our Alaska fly fishing trips.
